chapter.heading: Psalm 36
How Precious Is Your Steadfast Love
To the choirmaster. Of David, the servant of the LORD.
chapter.v: that his iniquity cannot be found out and hated .
he has ceased to act wisely and do good .
man and beast yousave , O Lord .
The children of mankind take refugein the shadow of your wings .
and you give them drink fromthe river ofyour delights .
in your light do we see light .
and your righteousness tothe upright of heart !
nor the hand of the wicked drive me away .
they are thrust down ,unable to rise .
